intro: Hold ⌃⌥ and press R: a ring opens at the pointer. Move towards a direction to preview, release ⌃⌥ (or click) to apply, Esc to cancel. The centre maximizes. The window goes to the display under the pointer.
intro.short: Snap the window you are in with a ring at the pointer or a shortcut.
